sentences.text:
Author: Sandeep Sharma
Bench: Sandeep Sharma
Yogesh Kumar versus State of H.P & another Cr.MMO No. 249 of 2023 .
Present: Mr. H.S Rangra, Advocate, for the petitioner.

Mr. Pushpinder Jaswal, Mr. Jitender Sharma, Mr. Tejasvi Sharma, Addl.A.Gs. with Mr. Gautam
Sood, Dy.A.G for respondent No.1.

By way of instant petition filed under Section 482 Cr.PC, prayer has been made on behalf of the
petitioner for quashing of Fir No. 24 of 2022 dated 14.03.2022, under Sections 376(2) and 506 of
Ipc readwith Section 6 of Prevention of Child from Sexual Offences Act 2012 (Pocso), registered at
P.S. Karsog, District Mandi, H.P., as well as consequent proceedings pending before the Court below
on the basis of amicable settlement arrived inter-se parties.

entities.text: Prevention of Child from Sexual Offences Act 2012 (Pocso)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Mr. Pushpinder Jaswal, learned Additional Advocate General appears and waives service of notice on behalf of respondent No.1.

Though the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the parties have entered into a compromise and have resolved to settle their dispute amicably inter-se them, but this Court with a view to ascertain the genuineness and correctness of the compromise, deems it fit to summon respondent No.2 on the next date of hearing so that factum with regard to compromise arrived at inter-se the parties is ascertained.
List on 29.03.2023, on which date respondent No. No.2 shall remain present in Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioner undertakes to cause presence of respondent No.2 on the aforesaid date.

Learned Additional Advocate General is also directed to verify the aforesaid factum of compromise,
if any.
.

( Sandeep Sharma )
 March 22, 2023 Judge  (hemlata/priti)
